name: Apex Solventless | 1g Live Rosin Tier 1 | Rainbow Guava #2 (73-119u)
description:
Hunted in house and selected for its candy aroma, Rainbow Guava #2 is an indica-dominant hybrid rosin crafted from the vibrant cross of Rainbow Belts and Strawberry Guava. This concentrate captivates with its juicy tropical flavors, featuring ripe guava, citrus, and sweet berry notes. Known for its colorful buds and rich candy berry terpene profile, Rainbow Guava #2 delivers a smooth, flavorful experience paired with deeply relaxing effects.

Cross: Strawguava x Rainbow Belts

Terp Profile: Candy, Guava, Fruity
